staples.name: Bird Egg
staples.description: A common nesting egg gathered from Hyrule's birds. Reliable in omelets, crepes, and rice dishes when the road kitchen needs binding and lift.
staples.merchantNote: Pantry staple. Keeps if packed carefully. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Cane Sugar
staples.description: Sweet crystals traded for desserts and glazes. Alone it will not fill a belly, but it turns wheat and fruit into something worth celebrating at camp.
staples.merchantNote: Baker's coin. Pair with Tabantha Wheat. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Fresh Milk
staples.description: Creamy milk from Hyrule's herds. Softens soups and stews, and warms travellers when simmered alone on a quiet evening.
staples.merchantNote: Sold cool from the cart. Use soon. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Goat Butter
staples.description: Rich butter for risottos, pies, and anything that should taste like a proper inn kitchen rather than a skewer over coals.
staples.merchantNote: A cook's quiet luxury. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Goron Spice
staples.description: A bold blend favored in Goron cooking. Turns rice, meat, and greens into fragrant curries and sautés with very little fuss.
staples.merchantNote: Smells like the mountain markets. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Hylian Rice
staples.description: Staple grain for bowls, balls, pilafs, and curries. When the satchel is light on meat, rice still builds a meal.

staples.name: Monster Extract
staples.description: A peculiar concentrate associated with Fang and Bone. Unpredictable in the pot—useful for monster dishes, never for careful travellers who want certainty.
staples.merchantNote: Sold with a warning label and a wink. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Raw Bird Drumstick
staples.description: Everyday poultry from smaller birds. Fine for stews, skewers, and rice bowls when you need meat without the gourmet price.
staples.merchantNote: Trail protein, properly wrapped. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Raw Bird Thigh
staples.description: Prime cut from larger fowl. Steps up poultry pilafs and meat-and-rice bowls when the road ahead looks long.
staples.merchantNote: Better birds, better bowls. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Raw Gourmet Meat
staples.description: Top-tier red meat for gourmet stews, curries, and skewers. Heavy in the satchel, heavier in the pot.
staples.merchantNote: For celebrations and hard climbs. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Raw Meat
staples.description: Standard red meat from Hyrule's wildlife. The workhorse ingredient behind stews, pies, and pepper steaks.
staples.merchantNote: Honest meat at an honest (fictional) price.

staples.name: Raw Prime Meat
staples.description: A finer cut than ordinary meat. Elevates curries, rice bowls, and salt-grilled plates without requiring gourmet luck.

staples.name: Raw Whole Bird
staples.description: An entire bird for gourmet poultry dishes. Pack it when you mean to cook for a party—or one very hungry hero.
staples.merchantNote: Special-order energy, shelf-stocked when the hunt is good. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Rock Salt
staples.description: Mineral salt for grilling, seasoning, and bread. The difference between a skewer and a supper.
staples.merchantNote: Cheap, essential, always in the front crate. Pricing is fictional.

staples.name: Tabantha Wheat
staples.description: Northern grain for breads, pies, stews, and crepes. If the recipe needs a crust or a thickener, start here.
staples.merchantNote: Milled for travellers who still bake. Pricing is fictional.
